subject: maths
question: Which of the following is equal to (1)/(tan theta) + tan θ ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume θ = 45°.

Expression = 1/tan 45° + tan 45° = 1/1 + 1 = 2.

Check Option (1): sec 45° × cosec 45° = √2 × √2 = 2.

Matches the value of the expression.

**∴ The correct answer is sec θ.cosec θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (1 / tan θ) + tan θ

**Formula Used:** tan θ = sin θ / cos θ, cot θ = cos θ / sin θ, and sin² θ + cos² θ = 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5c5d84bb026530027ec7e617722dd219f5e0259f20b76883ac0384447bbf05c.png] 

⇒ 1/tan θ + tan θ = cot θ + tan θ

⇒ (cos θ / sin θ) + (sin θ / cos θ)

⇒ Take LCM of denominators: sin θ × cos θ

⇒ (cos² θ + sin² θ) / (sin θ × cos θ)

⇒ 1 / (sin θ × cos θ) [Since sin² θ + cos² θ = 1]

⇒ (1 / sin θ) × (1 / cos θ)

⇒ cosec θ × sec θ

**∴ The correct answer is sec θ.cosec θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fundamental Trigonometric Identities

There are three primary identities: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Reciprocal Relations

cosec θ = 1/sin θ, sec θ = 1/cos θ, and cot θ = 1/tan θ.

Complementary Angles

Trigonometric ratios of (90° − θ): sin(90°−θ) = cosθ, tan(90°−θ) = cotθ, and sec(90°−θ) = cosecθ.</p
